About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Want to make an impact by innovating how top global companies build teams and adapt to the Future of Work? As an Account Executive, you’ll have the opportunity to target and close net new accounts, as well as re-engage dormant accounts. Success in this role comes from your skills in res [...]  take ownership of your accounts, successes, and failures.
You are a go-getter. We are looking for self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts and think about target accounts as their own business. You aren’t afraid to do the work required to reach your goals by following a process and being creative.
You don’t take yourself too seriously; you have a sense of humor and are comfortable with sarcasm. This position does sit on our Sales teams, after all.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

Job Summary
As a Toptal Business Solutions Specialist, you will be working directly with Toptal’s clients to understand their needs, custom-match them with Management Consultants from our talent network, and provide support during the matching process, throughout the engagement, and beyond.
This is  [...] nt, Design, Digital Marketing.
Ability to understand ambiguous business needs and translate them to a consultant’s responsibilities and skills.
Excellent communication, relationship development and emotional intelligence skills to qualify a consulting project, and to assess fit with the best consultant or team of consultants.
Understanding of business strategy and management consulting concepts, playbooks and frameworks (MBA is an advantage but not required).
Ability to quickly adopt new processes and technologies.
Ability to adhere to tight deadlines and thrive under pressure.
Strong strategic thinking skills.
Self-starter who can execute with limited guidance.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Position Description:

You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering [...] tributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.

Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.

Job Summary
Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem b [...] ectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request isn’t the best path to their goal.
Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isn’t the right answer.
Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.
